correctness.rationale: The table-level guarantee semantics reduces the only failure to opposite singleton guarantees of pure nonempty rows/columns; rectangle enumeration follows by unique occupied support. Sparse disjoint occupied cells yield independent Poisson(c/2) colors and rectangle limit e^-c(1+c). The upper window mp=2 log m+t uses joint factorial moments of four rare pure-line types; intersections affect probability o(1) and the conditional required-color probability tends to one. Off-window bounds from mq_m establish both zero-one regimes. The nearly-complete law follows from Poisson missing cells. m=1,2,3 direct modal truth-set enumeration gave 3,61,11115 valid tables and independent rectangle check 3,41,1179; finite tests not infinite proofs.
